hypotheses.statement: Couriers reach the payment step from their route without help.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Most couriers complete t1 without help.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Fewer than half of the couriers complete t1 without help.

hypotheses.statement: Couriers can find where the total to collect is shown.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Most couriers find the total in t2.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Most couriers cannot find the total in t2.

instrument.intro: TEST DATA. Thank you for helping. We are testing a prototype, not you. There are no wrong answers and you can stop at any time.
instrument.consent: TEST DATA. With your permission we record what happens on screen and keep it without your name.
instrument.closing: Thank you. That is all we needed.

questions.text: How long have you delivered parcels?
TEST DATA. A customer opens the door and wants to pay for their parcel in cash. Take the payment.

task.success: The pay screen is reached from the route.

questions.text: TEST DATA. Before you ring the bell you want to know how much cash to ask for. Find that amount.

task.success: The participant names the total shown on the pay screen.
